## What's new

- **macOS:** NDM now runs on Macs, as one app for Apple Silicon and Intel (`NDM-2.0.0-macOS.dmg`, macOS 11 or later). It has the menu bar icon, the browser extension, the system proxy and PAC scripts, VPN connections, the sounds, start at login, and downloading over several networks at once. The first time, right-click NDM in Applications and choose **Open** (it isn't notarized by Apple).
- **ARM:** Windows 11 on ARM gets its own setup (`NDM-ARM64-Setup-2.0.0.exe`), and Linux on aarch64 (Raspberry Pi 4/5, ARM laptops and servers) its own AppImage, .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz. "Check for updates" picks the file made for your system and processor.
- **Portable Windows zips** (`NDM-2.0.0-windows-x64.zip`, `-arm64.zip`): unpack and run `ndm.exe` from any folder, no setup.
- **Spanish, French and Arabic** (**View → Language**). Arabic is right to left: every window, list, tab and menu bar is mirrored, checkboxes and radio buttons have their box on the right, progress bars fill from the right, and the text is joined and ordered for reading. A translation that is longer than the English is drawn a little smaller instead of being cut off or running into the next control.
- **Faster downloads:**
  - new connections open every quarter second until the download runs at full speed (was once a second), so a download reaches its top speed within about a second;
  - connections stay open between the parts of a download (keep-alive) and the server's address is remembered, so a new part starts without a new connection and name lookup;
  - a server that allows fewer connections (answers "busy" or "too many requests") no longer fails the download: NDM keeps to the number it allows and goes on;
  - on Windows the file is made sparse while it downloads, so a large file doesn't have to be written full of zeros first.
- **Starts where it used to fail:**
  - when the graphics driver can't run OpenGL (virtual machines, remote desktops, old or missing drivers) NDM starts again with Direct3D 12 / Vulkan / Metal, or Windows' software renderer, instead of not opening;
  - when another program already uses NDM's browser port, NDM takes the next free one and the extension finds it.

## Fixed

- Untranslated text in a few windows (the OK button, the progress window's Pause button, the scheduler's weekdays and modes, message windows, menu items), and the date format in the download list, which used English month names in every language.
- The Linux tray menu now changes language with the rest of NDM.
- The Sounds list in Options lines its events up under the column header.
